note: Inputs reference context.templates by templateId and context.layers by layer hash. Compare decision, failing, results (layer, id, result, reason), statementsUsed, statementsRejected, inputsHash and effectiveHash. Cost units and messages are implementation-defined.

owner-wallet/procurement@1.description: Bounded procurement budget for an agent: agent + co-signer spend within policy; the owner (treasury) can always act alone (catalog B1)

settlement-vault/hotel@1.description: Prepaid booking with confirmation deadline, dispute window and arbiter (docs/use-cases/hotel-booking.md)

owner-wallet/shopping@1.description: Bounded consumer-shopping budget for an agent: agent + co-signer spend within a weekly cap to category-approved merchants; the owner can always act alone (catalog R2)

settlement-vault/hotel@2.description: Prepaid booking with deposit, check-in/no-show handling, dispute windows, arbiter and backup arbiter (hotel stay escrow)

rules.check: tx.account == eng.account && tx.innerAccounts().all(a, a == eng.account || (stage == 'open' && eng.parties.exists(k, eng.parties[k] == a)))
rules.message: Only transactions from the engagement account (plus the funder at open) may be co-signed.
Transaction types allowed in this stage are limited; installing a RegularKey is never allowed.
Fee above the cap would drain the account's XRP.

rules.check: stage in params.presignedStages || (tx.hasLastLedgerSequence && tx.lastLedgerSequence <= ledgerIndex + params.maxLedgerWindow)
rules.message: Live transactions need a short LastLedgerSequence.
Batches must be ALLORNOTHING.
Payouts may only go to engagement parties, the fee account, child engagements, or mandate vendors.
A closing Batch must drain the asset exactly, remove the trust line, and delete to the service/sponsor.
Every co-signed transaction records its basis (eng/basis memo).
Another co-signed outcome for this engagement is still in flight.
Every amount must use the policy's declared issuer.
Pre-signed outcomes are single-shot: complete only when the ledger state makes them succeed exactly.
A valid, unexpired mandate signed by the owner is required.
Spends are 1–4 payments to vendors.

rules.check: tx.payouts.destinations().all(d, d in mandate.vendors && ledger.hasCredential(d, params.kybType, params.kybIssuers))
rules.message: Every payee must be a mandate vendor holding a KYB credential from an accepted issuer.
Daily outflow cap.
Mandate budget (90 days).

rules.check: tx.payouts.count() == 1 && att.list('approval.payment/1', 'approver').exists(a, a.subject.intentHash == tx.intentHash() && now < timestamp(a.claim.notAfter))
rules.message: Payments above the threshold need a single-use approval bound to this payment intent.

rules.check: tx.payouts.items.all(p, att.list('party.invoice/1', 'vendor').exists(i, i.attester.account == p.to && amt(i.claim.amount, 'RLUSD') == p.amount && i.claim.invoiceRef == tx.memo('eng/invoice')))
rules.message: Each payment must match a vendor-signed invoice (amount and invoice reference).
The payment must match the x402 challenge: destination, amount and invoice binding.
Owner close: sweep to the owner, remove the trust line, delete.

rules.check: att.latest('party.confirmation/1', 'counterparty').claim.city == mandate.constraints.city && att.latest('party.confirmation/1', 'counterparty').claim.checkIn == mandate.constraints.checkIn && att.latest('party.confirmation/1', 'counterparty').claim.checkOut == mandate.constraints.checkOut

rules.message: A valid, unexpired mandate signed by the owner is required.
Spends are 1–4 payments to merchants.

rules.check: tx.payouts.destinations().all(d, att.list('merchant.category/1', 'classifier').exists(c, c.subject.account == d && c.claim.category in mandate.categories))
rules.message: Every payee must be classified by an accepted classifier into a category the mandate allows.
Rolling 7-day outflow cap.
Mandate budget (90 days).
The payment must match the agent's x402/MPP challenge: destination, amount and invoice binding.
Owner close: sweep to the owner, remove the trust line, delete.

definitions.confirmed: def.conf != null && def.conf.claim.mandateHash == eng.mandateId && def.conf.claim.city == mandate.constraints.city && def.conf.claim.checkIn == mandate.constraints.checkIn && def.conf.claim.checkOut == mandate.constraints.checkOut && amt(def.conf.claim.total.value, 'RLUSD') == def.booked && def.deposit <= amt(mandate.constraints.maxDeposit.value, 'RLUSD')
definitions.checkedIn: def.conf != null && att.latest('party.checkin/1', 'counterparty') != null && att.latest('party.checkin/1', 'counterparty').claim.status == 'checked_in' && def.balance >= def.booked + def.deposit
definitions.disputeOpen: ledger.credentialExists(eng.parties.principal, eng.account, 'ENG/DISPUTE') && size(def.disputes) > 0 && def.balance >= def.booked + (def.checkedIn ? def.deposit : zero('RLUSD')) + amt(params.minDisputeBond, 'RLUSD')
definitions.conceded: def.entryDispute && att.list('party.concession/1', 'counterparty').exists(c, def.disputes.exists(d, d.claim.phase == 'entry' && d.id == c.claim.disputeRef))
definitions.disputeOpenedAt: size(def.settlementDisputes) > 0 ? (timestamp(def.settlementDisputes[0].issuedAt) > timestamp(eng.timers.deliveryBy) ? timestamp(def.settlementDisputes[0].issuedAt) : timestamp(eng.timers.deliveryBy)) : (timestamp(def.entryDisputes[0].issuedAt) > timestamp(eng.timers.checkIn) ? timestamp(def.entryDisputes[0].issuedAt) : timestamp(eng.timers.checkIn))

rules.message: The hotel's confirmation must reference the guest's mandate.

rules.check: def.conf.claim.city == mandate.constraints.city && def.conf.claim.checkIn == mandate.constraints.checkIn && def.conf.claim.checkOut == mandate.constraints.checkOut
rules.message: City and dates must match the mandate.
The confirmed total must equal the booked amount.
The deposit may not exceed the mandate's maxDeposit.
The hotel must record the guest as checked in.
The account must hold the room plus exactly the confirmed deposit.
An agreed settlement is a close.split Batch.
The service fee is 50 bps of everything the hotel receives.
A stay that happened settles with the guest's review.
Settlement pays only the guest, the hotel and the fee account.
Needs an open entry dispute and the hotel's concession referencing it.
A conceded refund is a close.refundAll Batch.
Everything in the account goes to the guest, with no fee.
Refund only after confirmBy when the booking was never confirmed.
The account must hold exactly the room amount.
The refund default is a close.refundAll Batch.
No-show only after both checkInBy and entryDisputeBy.
Only a confirmed booking can be a no-show.
The guest was recorded as checked in.
A guest dispute is open.
The account must hold exactly the room amount.
The no-show default is a close.releaseAll Batch.
The service fee is 50 bps of everything the hotel receives.
Release only after the dispute window, for a stay that happened.
A guest dispute is open.
The account must hold exactly the room plus the deposit.
The release default is a close.releaseWithDeposit Batch.
The hotel posted a deposit claim; it goes to settlement or a ruling.

rules.check: def.toGuest == def.deposit && def.toFee == bps(def.toMerchant + def.toFee, params.serviceFeeBps)
rules.message: The deposit returns to the guest; the room goes to the hotel less the fee.

rules.check: (def.disputeOpen && now > def.disputeOpenedAt + duration(params.rulingWindow)) || (def.claim != null && !def.disputeOpen && now > timestamp(eng.timers.disputeWindowEnds) + duration(params.rulingWindow))
rules.message: The backup arbiter may rule only after the primary's ruling window.
The primary arbiter has ruled.
Needs a ruling from the backup arbiter.

rules.check: size(def.backupRuling.claim.payouts) == tx.payouts.count() && def.backupRuling.claim.payouts.all(p, def.backupRuling.claim.payouts.filter(q, q.to == p.to).size() == 1 && tx.payouts.to(p.to, 'RLUSD') == amt(p.value, 'RLUSD')) && tx.payouts.destinations().all(d, def.backupRuling.claim.payouts.exists(p, p.to == d))
rules.message: The transaction must pay exactly the backup ruling's payouts.
A ruling is a close.split Batch.
The service fee is 50 bps of everything the hotel receives.
A default ruling needs a posted claim.
The guest disputed; the arbiter rules on the dispute instead.
The guest may answer the claim until disputeWindowEnds.
Claims are capped at the deposit.

rules.check: def.toMerchant + def.toFee == def.booked + def.claimTotal && def.toGuest == def.deposit - def.claimTotal && def.toFee == bps(def.toMerchant + def.toFee, params.serviceFeeBps)
rules.message: Room plus claim to the hotel (less fee), the deposit remainder to the guest.
